title: The Teal Agave - 5BR Home, Heated Pool & Hot Tub!
description:
Gorgeous Modern Home minutes from Old Town - Sleeps 12 in Comfort & Luxury - Pool, Hot Tub & Large Yard!

✴ Heated Pool, Installed in Summer 2023! ✴

Enjoy our heated pool, newly installed in Summer 2023, and ready for your stay. Pool heating is available upon request and requires an additional fee.

 The space 
Pool Heat Fee: $75/night from October-April, $25/night for the rest of the year (often not needed). A 2-night minimum is generally required, with discounts available for heating requests of 5 nights or more.

Early Check-In and Early Check-Out:
Subject to availability, early check-in and early check-out are each available for an additional fee of $100.

Note: There is no parking garage.

✴DESTINATION: SCOTTSDALE!

This is your ideal haven for Family Reunions, Bachelor/Bachelorette Gatherings (no parties- just your group, please!), Golf Trips, Spring Training, Couples’ Getaways, and anyone wanting to spend some time in the heart of Old Town Scottsdale and experience all that this amazing city offers.

✴LOCATION LOCATION LOCATION!

Convenient access to Old Town, Papago, Phoenix Zoo, and more! UBER or Lyft are readily available.

✴A BREATH OF FRESH AIR

This is a SMOKE-FREE & PET-FREE home. In the event that you will be traveling with a service animal, please ask the host to send over the Courteous Conduct and Cleanliness Agreement for your review and agreement prior to your stay.

✴WHAT MAKES US SPECIAL

The Teal Agave was professionally designed with high-end furnishings and 5-star hotel quality amenities to pamper you in luxury. With a great deal of love and TLC, we carefully selected our favorite organic bath products, specialty coffee, fluffy spa-like towels, linens, etc. that are typically found in your favorite hotels. Enjoy the comforts of being in a luxury home with the perks of a fancy hotel!

As your hosts, our aim is to give you the wonderful service you seek when on vacation. You will love our house book with TONS of suggestions on: dining, golf, restaurants, nightlife, family fun, etc. We love sharing our love of Scottsdale with our guests.

✴ COVID-19

To help battle COVID-19, we are taking extra steps to ensure that you feel confident in making our home your safe place to escape! Our cleaners are being extra vigilant - In addition to their spectacular routine cleanings, they are giving extra attention to the high-touch areas, with Isopropyl alcohol-based cleaners, such as doorknobs, counters, light switches, and remotes

Scottsdale City's maximum family size is 6 adults and their related dependent children.
Scottsdale license number: 2023756
Arizona TPT license number: 21342070

 Guest access 
You'll have access to the entire house with the exception of locked cabinets where extra supplies are stored.

 Other things to note 
There is a video doorbell outside the front door, which records 30 seconds of the front yard upon motion detection. There is also a noise decibel monitor on at all times, which does not record audio but tracks how loud the general environment is.

To help us ensure a smooth and safe experience for everyone, we kindly ask that all guests provide a secondary contact number after booking. This can be your own number or someone else’s who will be staying at the property, just in case we need to reach you quickly in an emergency.

If you're booking on behalf of someone else and won’t be present during the stay, we simply ask for a contact number for the guest who will be staying.

We’ll always respect your privacy and only use this information if absolutely necessary. Thanks so much for your understanding
